label: Completeness
definition: The proportion of stored data against the potential of being 100% complete.
source: DAMA UK / Government Data Quality Framework

label: Uniqueness
definition: Nothing will be recorded more than once based upon how that thing is identified.
source: DAMA UK / Government Data Quality Framework

label: Consistency
definition: The absence of difference when comparing two or more representations of a thing against a definition.
source: DAMA UK / Government Data Quality Framework

label: Timeliness
definition: The degree to which data represent reality from the required point in time.
source: DAMA UK / Government Data Quality Framework

label: Validity
definition: Data are valid if they conform to the syntax (format, type, range) of their definition.
source: DAMA UK / Government Data Quality Framework

label: Accuracy
definition: The degree to which data correctly describe the real-world object or event being described.
source: DAMA UK / Government Data Quality Framework

label: Representativeness
definition: The degree to which data cover, and are equally good for, every group of people they describe. Extension proposed by this project; not one of the six DAMA UK dimensions.

label: Metadata quality
definition: The degree to which an asset is described well enough to find, understand, trust and reuse it. Covers GOV.UK critical data asset metadata and DAM policy duties.
source: This project (from GOV.UK DAM policy and CDA metadata guidance)

label: Relevance
definition: Whether the data meets the needs of users. ESS 'plus' dimension, assessed mainly by qualitative evidence.
source: European Statistical System quality framework (used in the IOPC data trust scales)

label: Coherence and comparability
definition: Whether the data is coherent with other sources and comparable over time and between areas. ESS 'plus' dimension.
source: European Statistical System quality framework (used in the IOPC data trust scales)

label: Accessibility and clarity
definition: Whether the data is clear, released in a convenient form, and has supporting metadata and guidance. ESS 'plus' dimension.
source: European Statistical System quality framework (used in the IOPC data trust scales)
